Reads previous component full length via GetLength, then IsTransition.

For a segment preceding a transition, inserts tree contribution fullLength-(previousTransitionLength+nextTransitionLength); otherwise fullLength-previousTransitionLength. Transition contribution is its fullLength. Fields correspond to serialized component list read by the AVB path.

Compares full component start against requested end (start>=end stops); clips child end to min(fullLength,requestEnd-componentStart), child start to max(0,requestStart-componentStart). Supports half-open intervals.
Returns signed recorded source position from offset0x98.
Writes source MobDesc.position = storedSourcePosition + requestedLocalOffset; these are source-clip edit units before resolving the Mob reference.
Converts source position to selected child edit rate via ConvertEUs, then invokes composition virtual slot0xb10 (CvtPositionToOffset) with selected track.
Separately converts position+length and subtracts converted position to obtain resolved length. This is endpoint conversion, not separately rounded duration.

Computes coordinate*destinationRate/sourceRate, adds sign-dependent bias, then truncates toward zero. Positive path uses+0.5; negative bias literal not independently decoded in this bounded audit, so no complete signed rounding implementation is prescribed.
Reads group/child ExactEditRate and calls ConvertEUsFloor for a requested offset.
On the IsComposition branch: maps start with ConvertEUsFloor and exclusive end with ConvertEUsCeil from group edit rate to child rate, then passes mapped start/end to child visitor.
Other groups consult virtual slot0x8a8 (MapRangeDown) for source range before walking children; do not assume universal identity mapping through arbitrary effects.
Obtains TrackInfo through RefTrackInfo and reads start_pos at offset0x28.
Calls GetStart through virtual slot0xb00, then returns coordinate+start_pos.

supportedImplementationConclusions: For normal serialized SEQU with established component order and lengths: total timeline length equals sum(nontransition full lengths)-sum(transition lengths). Each transition overlaps adjacent full segments. This is algebraic inference from native AVB reader tree contribution, not runtime playback acceptance.

Equivalent serialized layout: advance cursor by a segment full length; when encountering a transition, subtract its length before assigning its interval; leave that cursor as next segment full start. This makes both neighboring full source windows overlap over transition duration.
Transition cut point divides the transition length into cutPoint and length-cutPoint, but is not a second duration to subtract from the whole sequence.
Normal interval clipping can use half-open [start,end).

A source clip local offset first adds SourceClip.start_time, before converting to target child edit rate. ResolveMobRef uses endpoint conversion and applies target composition track start_pos by addition after conversion.

Safe initial normal-source subset: known positive equal edit rates and exact integer intervals; absent/conflicting rates/origins or fractional mapping can retain other proven media while reporting a Console mapping gap.

The native composition visitor separately supports floor-start/ceil-end conversion when descending composition tracks. This is distinct from ResolveMobRef conversion; do not silently use one rounding rule everywhere.
Arbitrary transition effect input topology and arbitrary track-group/effect source ranges still require established semantic mapping; generic identity mapping has not been proven.
limits: Static disassembly only: no Media Composer playback/timeline/export comparison or exact-media oracle.

No general transition-input topology, transition effect-specific handle consumption, signed generic conversion rounding, cross-rate source reference acceptance, or every kind of nested effect was established.
Physical file association and original/render links remain separate from interval pruning policy.
Selectors/disabled tracks/speed effects were assigned to another audit agent.
Other class-specific overrides, effect extensions and generic source-reference rounding remain outside this default-method follow-up.
